metadata.description: Questions requiring the system to produce a semester-by-semester plan. Every question is grounded in a specific persona. Draft answers require advisor validation.

questions.persona_summary: CS Senior, BA minor, 49 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I'm planning to graduate in Spring 2026. I have my BA minor and most of my CS courses done. Can you lay out exactly what I need to take in my final semester to finish everything?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Tight single-semester plan with no flexibility. System must verify both CS and BA minor completion, identify any gaps, and confirm all remaining courses are offered Spring 2026.
needs_verification: Exact remaining CS requirements for P-007
Exact remaining BA minor requirements for P-007
All remaining courses offered in Spring 2026
Total units fit within semester limit

questions.persona_summary: IS Senior, ISP concentration, History minor, 46 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I have Fall 2025 and Spring 2026 left. I still need a couple of ISP electives and a History minor course. Can you plan both semesters so I graduate on time, making sure I take things in the right order?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Must sequence ISP courses with prerequisites correctly across 2 semesters while fitting History minor courses into remaining slots.
needs_verification: Remaining ISP elective requirements for P-020
Remaining History minor requirements for P-020
Prerequisite ordering among remaining ISP courses
Course availability in Fall 2025 and Spring 2026

questions.persona_summary: BA Junior, dual concentration Finance + BAT, Econ minor, 37 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I have 3 semesters left and I'm doing Finance, BAT, and an Econ minor. There's a lot to fit in. Can you give me a semester-by-semester plan that gets everything done without overloading me?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Dual concentration + minor = complex requirement set. Multiple valid plans exist. System should balance workload across semesters rather than front-loading.
needs_verification: Double-counting rules between concentrations and minor

questions.persona_summary: CS 5th-year, no minor, 52 courses, Academic warning
questions.question: I'm on academic warning and I need to graduate this year. Can you plan my remaining semesters given that I have a limited number of units I can take?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Academic warning unit cap directly constrains the plan. System must know the cap, calculate unit totals, and possibly acknowledge that an extra semester is needed.
needs_verification: Academic warning unit cap from policy data
Exact remaining CS requirements for P-009
Whether remaining requirements fit within unit cap across available semesters

questions.persona_summary: BIO Senior, no concentration, no minor, 53 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I want to graduate by Spring 2026 but I'm worried I have too many courses left. Would it help to take summer courses? Can you plan it out with and without summer?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: System should present two plans — one with summer, one without — and explain the tradeoff. Tests whether system considers summer as a planning option.
needs_verification: Remaining BIO degree requirements for P-037
Summer course offerings and any summer unit limits
Whether graduation is feasible without summer

questions.persona_summary: BA Senior, Entrepreneurship concentration, Media & Politics minor, 47 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: One course only offered in specific semester
questions.question: I need to finish my Entrepreneurship concentration and Media & Politics minor by Spring 2026. Some of these courses are only offered once a year. Can you make sure my plan accounts for that?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Forces the system to check course offering frequency and assign courses to the only semester they're available, building the rest of the plan around those anchors.
needs_verification: Which courses are offered only in Fall or only in Spring
Whether all remaining courses are available before Spring 2026

questions.persona_summary: BIO Junior, CS minor, 36 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Must take prereqs before target course
questions.question: I'm a Bio major with a CS minor. I still need to finish the CS minor prerequisite chain. Can you plan my remaining semesters so I complete both my Bio requirements and CS minor?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: CS minor has a strict prereq chain (15-112 → 15-122 → ...) that must be sequenced correctly. Bio requirements must be interleaved around it.
needs_verification: Which CS minor prereqs P-036 has completed
Course availability for CS minor courses at CMU-Q

questions.persona_summary: BA Senior, dual concentration Finance + Strategic Mgmt, Media & Politics minor, 54 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I'm doing Finance, Strategic Management, and a Media & Politics minor. It's been extremely tight. Can you plan my final semesters to make sure I haven't missed anything?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Most complex requirement set in the BA cohort. System must track requirements across two concentrations plus a minor and verify completeness.
needs_verification: Whether all remaining courses can fit in final semesters

questions.persona_summary: BIO 5th-year, no concentration, no minor, entered Fall 2020, 66 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I've been here since Fall 2020 and I've taken 66 courses. I just want to finally graduate. What do I actually still need, and when should I take it?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: System must audit a very long course history against current requirements. Some courses from earlier years might not count under current catalog. Edge case of long enrollment.
needs_verification: Which of 66 courses satisfy current BIO degree requirements
Whether any old courses no longer count

questions.persona_summary: IS Senior, ISP concentration, Dean's List, 49 courses
questions.question: I'm close to finishing my ISP concentration and I have a couple of free elective slots. I want to graduate with the strongest possible transcript for cybersecurity employers. What should I take and when?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Plan should optimize elective choices for career relevance, not just satisfy minimum requirements. Tests whether system goes beyond bare requirement satisfaction.

questions.persona_summary: IS First-year, Data Science concentration, 14 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: First-year adding a minor — plenty of time
questions.question: I'm in my first year doing IS with Data Science. I'm thinking about adding a Business Administration minor. Can you plan out all four years including the minor?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Long-horizon planning with many valid approaches. Tests whether system can produce a reasonable 4-year plan.
needs_verification: IS + Data Science full requirement list
Overlap between IS courses and BA minor

questions.persona_summary: IS Sophomore, ISP concentration, 24 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I'm currently in ISP but I'm also interested in Data Science. Is it possible to add DS as a second concentration? If so, what would my plan look like?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Dual concentration feasibility assessment + plan. Must check overlap between ISP and DS requirements.
needs_verification: Whether dual IS concentration is permitted by policy

questions.persona_summary: BA Junior, Strategic Management, no minor, 40 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Junior adding a minor — tight fit
questions.question: I'm a junior in Strategic Management with no minor. I want to add an Economics minor. Is it too late? If not, plan it out for me.
questions.what_makes_this_hard: System must first determine feasibility (can remaining requirements + new minor fit in remaining semesters?), then produce a plan only if feasible.
needs_verification: Which Econ minor courses P-055 may have already taken
Whether everything fits in remaining semesters

questions.persona_summary: BIO Senior, Genetics concentration, no minor, 51 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Senior wanting to add minor — likely too late
questions.question: I'm a senior in Genetics and I want to add a Neuroscience minor before I graduate. Is this possible in my remaining time?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: System should honestly assess that adding a minor as a senior is likely infeasible, explain why, and suggest alternatives.
needs_verification: Which Neuro minor courses P-062 may have already taken via Genetics
Whether any overlap makes it feasible

questions.persona_summary: CS Sophomore, BA minor, 23 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Minor overlaps with major — exploit double-counting
questions.question: I already have a BA minor. I've noticed some BA courses also count toward general education. Can you plan my remaining semesters to maximize this overlap and lighten my load?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Tests whether system identifies double-counting opportunities and exploits them to create an efficient plan.
needs_verification: Double-counting policy between BA minor and CS gen-ed requirements
Remaining CS + BA minor requirements for P-003

questions.persona_summary: BIO Junior, BA minor, 33 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Minor requires prereqs student hasn't started
questions.question: I want to finish my BA minor but I haven't taken some of the prerequisite business courses yet. Can you plan how to fit the remaining prereqs and minor courses into my schedule?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: BA minor prereqs create an internal chain within the minor. System must sequence prereqs before upper-level minor courses, all while maintaining Bio major progress.
needs_verification: Which BA minor prereqs P-063 has completed
Whether prereq chain fits in remaining semesters

questions.persona_summary: BIO Sophomore, no concentration, Neuroscience minor, 23 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Adding a second minor on top of existing one
questions.question: I already have a Neuroscience minor. I'm also interested in adding a Psychology minor. Is it feasible to do both plus my Bio major? What would the plan look like?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Double-minor feasibility. System must check total remaining requirements for Bio + Neuro minor + Psych minor and determine if they fit.
needs_verification: Overlap between Neuroscience and Psychology minors
Total remaining course count for all three
Whether double-minor is permitted by policy

questions.persona_summary: BA First-year, BAT concentration, 13 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I'm currently in Business Analytics & Technologies but I'm thinking about switching to Information Systems entirely. What courses would transfer and what would I need to start from scratch? Can you show me both paths — staying in BA vs switching to IS?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Cross-major comparison. Must identify transferable courses, new requirements, and produce two complete plans.
needs_verification: Which BA courses transfer to IS program

questions.persona_summary: BIO First-year, no concentration, no minor, 11 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I'm a Bio first-year and I want to add a Computer Science minor for bioinformatics. The CS prereq chain seems long. Can you plan all four years with the CS minor included?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: CS minor has the longest prereq chain (15-112 → 15-122 → 15-213 → ...) for non-CS students. Must start immediately and interleave with Bio requirements.
needs_verification: CS minor full requirement list and prereq chain
Which CS courses P-032 may have taken
Whether 4-year completion is feasible with both

questions.persona_summary: IS Junior, ISP concentration, Multidisciplinary Energy Studies minor, 36 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Minor with limited offerings at CMU-Q
questions.question: My Multidisciplinary Energy Studies minor has very few course offerings at CMU-Q. Can you plan my remaining semesters making sure I can actually complete this minor with the courses that are available?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Rare minor with unpredictable availability. System must check which Energy Studies courses are actually offered and plan around availability constraints.
needs_verification: Which Energy Studies courses are actually offered 2025-2026
Whether minor completion is feasible with current offerings

questions.persona_summary: IS Sophomore, no concentration, Academic warning, 25 courses
questions.question: I'm on academic warning and I haven't even picked a concentration yet. I still want to graduate in 4 years. Can you help me plan a recovery path that stays within my unit limits?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Triple constraint — unit cap from warning, need to declare concentration, and 4-year graduation target. May not all be simultaneously satisfiable.
needs_verification: IS concentration options and their requirements
Which concentration P-013 is closest to based on courses taken
Whether 4-year graduation is feasible under unit cap

questions.persona_summary: CS Sophomore, no minor, 24 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Dropped a prerequisite course — cascading delay
questions.question: I dropped 15-122 this semester because I was struggling. How does this affect my plan for the rest of my CS degree? What's the cascading impact on courses that need 15-122 as a prereq?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Dropping a foundational course delays everything downstream. System must trace the prereq chain and show the cascade.
needs_verification: Full list of courses requiring 15-122 as prereq
P-002's remaining required courses that depend on 15-122

questions.persona_summary: BA Sophomore, Finance concentration, 25 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Failed a required course — retake planning
questions.question: I failed 70-122 and need to retake it. How should I adjust my plan? When is it offered again, and what does the repeat policy say about my GPA?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Requires knowing the retake policy, when the course is next offered, and how to rearrange the remaining plan to accommodate the retake.
needs_verification: Whether 70-122 is a prereq for other Finance courses
GPA impact rules for retaken courses

questions.persona_summary: BIO Sophomore, no concentration, no minor, 33 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Unfocused student — which concentration is closest?
questions.question: I've taken 33 courses but I still haven't declared a concentration. I've been exploring everything. Looking at what I've taken, which concentration am I closest to completing? Plan the most efficient path to graduation.
questions.what_makes_this_hard: System must analyze 33 courses against each possible BIO concentration to find the best fit, then build a plan around it.
needs_verification: How many requirements of each concentration P-061 has already satisfied
Which concentration requires the fewest additional courses

questions.persona_summary: IS 5th-year, Applied Informatics concentration, entered Fall 2019, 52 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Extended absence — requirements may have changed
questions.question: I entered in 2019 and I'm in Applied Informatics, which barely anyone else does. Have the IS requirements changed since I started? Do my old courses still count? Plan my final semesters.
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Catalog year issues — requirements may have changed. System needs to handle the 'which catalog year applies?' question and audit old courses against current requirements.
needs_verification: Whether Applied Informatics concentration still exists in current catalog
Catalog year policy (does student follow entry-year catalog?)
Differences between 2019 and current IS requirements
Which of P-019's courses satisfy current requirements

questions.persona_summary: IS Sophomore, Data Science concentration, BA minor, 27 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I just realized that one of the courses I took last semester doesn't actually count toward my Data Science concentration like I thought. What should I do now? Can you revise my plan?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: System must identify the miscount, determine what still needs to be taken, and fit the replacement into the remaining plan.
needs_verification: Which courses P-014 took that may not count

questions.persona_summary: BA First-year, dual concentration Global Economics & Finance, 12 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I want to graduate in 3 years instead of 4. I'm doing both Global Economics and Finance concentrations. Is this possible? Plan the most aggressive schedule that gets me out in 3 years.
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Maximum load planning. Dual concentration in 3 years likely requires overload semesters + summers. System must check overload policy and be honest about feasibility.
needs_verification: Full requirement list for BA + Global Economics + Finance
Minimum semesters needed given prereq chains

questions.persona_summary: CS Junior, no minor, 36 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I needed to take a specific systems elective that's only offered in Fall, and I missed it this Fall. What are my options? Can you replan my remaining semesters?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Must wait until next Fall or find an alternative. System must check if an equivalent course exists or if the plan must extend.

questions.persona_summary: CS 5th-year, entered Fall 2016, Academic warning, Math minor, 45 courses
questions.question: I've been here since 2016. I'm on academic warning and I have a Math minor. The CS curriculum has probably changed a lot since I started. Can you audit my courses against the current requirements and plan my path to graduation?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: The hardest recovery case. Entered 9+ years ago, on academic warning, with a minor. Maximum number of complicating factors.
needs_verification: Catalog year policy for long-enrolled students
Differences between 2016 and current CS requirements
Which of P-046's courses satisfy current requirements

questions.persona_summary: CS Junior, Tech Entrepreneurship minor, 34 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I'm planning to take next semester off for a startup internship. How should I rearrange my remaining semesters to still graduate on time? Do I need summer courses?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Removing one semester from the plan forces compression. System must determine if remaining requirements fit in fewer semesters, possibly with summer.
needs_verification: Remaining CS + Tech Entrepreneurship minor requirements
Whether requirements fit in reduced number of semesters

questions.persona_summary: IS Junior, Data Science concentration, Tech Entrepreneurship minor, 35 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I want to work in machine learning after graduation. Which electives should I take in my remaining semesters to best prepare for ML roles, given my Data Science concentration?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: System must identify ML-relevant electives from the catalog, check prerequisites, and sequence them into the remaining plan alongside DS requirements.
needs_verification: Which prereqs P-015 has already completed

questions.persona_summary: BA Senior, Strategic Management, Psychology minor, 57 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I'm a senior and I just want to finish with minimal stress. What's the lightest course load I can take each remaining semester while still meeting all my requirements?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Optimization in the opposite direction — minimize load per semester rather than minimize time. Must still satisfy all requirements.
needs_verification: Minimum unit requirements per semester (if any)

questions.persona_summary: CS Junior, Math minor, 33 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Wants to enable a specific advanced course
questions.question: I really want to take the advanced algorithms course before I graduate. What prerequisites do I need, and can you build them into my plan as electives?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Student has a target course. System must trace backwards through its prereq chain and fit the chain into the plan as electives.
needs_verification: Which 'advanced algorithms' course exists at CMU-Q
Whether the chain fits in remaining semesters

questions.persona_summary: IS Junior, ISP concentration, 39 courses, Good standing
questions.question: For my ISP concentration, I need to choose electives. Should I focus on network security courses or on cryptography courses? What does each path look like schedule-wise?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: System must present two elective tracks with their pros/cons and availability, letting the student make an informed choice.
needs_verification: ISP elective options in network security vs cryptography
Whether both tracks satisfy ISP requirements equally

questions.persona_summary: BIO Junior, Computational Biology + Neuroscience minors, 41 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Finding courses that satisfy multiple requirements
questions.question: I'm doing Comp Bio and Neuroscience minors. Are there any electives that count toward both? I need to find efficiencies because my schedule is packed.
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Tests whether the system can find overlapping courses between two requirement sets to create a more efficient plan.

questions.persona_summary: BIO First-year, Neuroscience concentration, 17 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I want to do undergraduate research starting junior year. What courses should I take in my first two years to be prepared? Build me a plan that prioritizes research readiness.
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Not just requirement satisfaction — the plan should sequence methods/lab courses early to enable research. Tests goal-directed planning.
needs_verification: Which courses provide research methodology training
Lab course availability in first two years
Whether front-loading methods courses delays other requirements

questions.persona_summary: CS Sophomore, Professional Writing minor, 24 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I have some free elective slots. I'm interested in design and user experience. What courses outside CS and my Writing minor could I take, and when do they fit?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: System must search across departments for relevant electives, check prerequisites, and fit them into available slots.

questions.persona_summary: IS Sophomore, ISP concentration, 24 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I want to eventually take the advanced cybersecurity capstone. What elective sequence do I need to take in what order to get there?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: System must trace a backwards chain from the target capstone through its prerequisites and build a multi-semester elective pathway.
needs_verification: Which capstone course exists for ISP

questions.persona_summary: CS Senior, dual minors BA + History, 60 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I have dual minors so I barely have any free slots. I think I have exactly 1 free elective slot left. What's the single best course I should take for my career in tech consulting?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Extreme constraint — only one slot. System must make a well-reasoned single-course recommendation given career goals.
needs_verification: Whether P-044 truly has only 1 free slot
Available courses in that slot's semester
Which courses are most relevant to tech consulting

questions.persona_summary: BIO Senior, Neuroscience minor, Dean's List, 55 courses
questions.variation: Preferred elective not offered — find alternative
questions.question: I really wanted to take the advanced neuroscience seminar this semester but it's not being offered. What's the best alternative that still strengthens my PhD application?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: System must find the unavailable course, understand what it covers, and identify the best available substitute.
needs_verification: Which advanced neuroscience seminar exists in catalog
Whether it's offered in current semester

questions.persona_summary: IS First-year, no concentration, 15 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: DS vs ISP concentration — full comparison
questions.question: I'm deciding between Data Science and Information Security. Can you show me what my full 4-year plan would look like for each? What are the differences in course load and flexibility?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Two complete 4-year plans side by side. System must produce both and compare workload, elective flexibility, and prerequisite pacing.

questions.persona_summary: BA First-year, Finance concentration, 13 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I want to add either an Economics minor or a History minor alongside my Finance concentration. Which one fits better into my plan? Show me both options.
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Two different minors with different requirements, prerequisites, and availability. System should compare total additional courses, scheduling ease, and overlap with Finance.
needs_verification: Overlap of each with Finance concentration

questions.persona_summary: BIO Sophomore, dual concentration Biochem + Computational Biology, 27 courses, Good standing
questions.question: My dual concentration is heavy. Can you show me a plan that finishes in 3 remaining semesters with a heavier load, versus 4 semesters with a lighter load? What's the tradeoff?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Explicit tradeoff analysis. One plan may require overload (triggering policy check), the other is more comfortable but delays graduation.

questions.persona_summary: CS Sophomore, no minor, 24 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Take hard course now vs later
questions.question: Should I take 15-213 this spring or wait until next fall? I've heard it's really tough. Can you show me how each choice affects the rest of my plan?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Sequencing strategy — taking it now enables more advanced courses sooner but increases current semester load. Taking it later constrains future options.
needs_verification: Impact on plan timeline for each choice
Current semester load if taken now

questions.persona_summary: BA Junior, Finance, History minor, 35 courses, Good standing
questions.question: I'm feeling behind. Should I take summer courses to catch up, or can I manage without? Show me both plans.
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Summer plan has cost/logistics implications. System should produce both and let the student decide.
needs_verification: Whether graduation is feasible without summer

questions.persona_summary: BA Sophomore, Finance, dual minors Econ + History, 25 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Overload one semester vs spread over two
questions.question: I have a lot of requirements left. Is it better to overload one semester to get ahead, or spread everything evenly? What does each plan look like?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Overload triggers policy check (GPA requirement). System must check if student qualifies and present both options with policy implications.
needs_verification: Plans for overload vs even distribution

questions.persona_summary: BIO Junior, Computational Biology + Neuroscience minors, 41 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Keep both minors vs drop one
questions.question: I'm worried two minors might delay me. Can you show me a plan with both minors versus dropping Neuroscience and just keeping Computational Biology? What do I lose by dropping it?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Tradeoff between academic breadth and graduation timeline. System should quantify the difference.
needs_verification: How many semesters each plan requires
Which courses become unnecessary if Neuro is dropped

questions.persona_summary: IS Sophomore, Data Science, HCI minor, 24 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Two elective paths toward same career goal
questions.question: I want to do UX research. Should I focus my electives on more HCI/design courses, or more data analytics/statistics courses? Show me both paths and their tradeoffs.
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Two different elective strategies for the same career goal. System should compare and recommend based on availability and career relevance.

questions.persona_summary: BIO First-year, dual concentration Genetics + Neuroscience, 11 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Keep both concentrations vs drop one
questions.question: I declared both Genetics and Neuroscience concentrations but I'm already overwhelmed. Can you show me the plan for keeping both versus dropping Genetics and just doing Neuroscience? How much lighter would it be?
questions.what_makes_this_hard: First-year rethinking an ambitious choice. System should show both plans and honestly quantify the workload difference.

questions.persona_summary: CS Junior, History minor, 33 courses, Good standing
questions.variation: Double major vs single major + minor
questions.question: I love both CS and History. Is it feasible to do a double major, or should I stick with CS major + History minor? Show me what a double major plan would look like versus my current path.
questions.what_makes_this_hard: Double major is ambitious and likely infeasible at CMU-Q. System should honestly assess feasibility and present the comparison.
needs_verification: Whether double major is permitted at CMU-Q
How many additional courses double major requires vs minor
Whether it fits in remaining semesters
